events.what: Fernández de Bobadilla and Pełka prove equimultiplicity of μ-constant families of isolated hypersurface singularities (Annals 2024)
TQFT/Floer re-proof of the family case
da Silva and Messias da Silva Júnior prove Zariski's multiplicity conjecture for 1-parameter families of quasihomogeneous corank-1 finitely-determined surface germs
Fernandes, Jelonek and Sampaio prove a metric (bi-Lipschitz) version for multiplicity two

judgement.doubts: The Fernández de Bobadilla–Pełka argument was first posted April 2022; the record asserts 'substantial revision' but shows no new mathematics in v5, so it is a pre-snapshot case (F7) and cannot set the status. Status stays partial only via the September 2025 quasihomogeneous-surface family case, which is unreviewed and whose setting (non-isolated image hypersurfaces of map germs) is narrow; if read as a variant, status would be open.

outcome_prefix: Judged: the status rests on da Silva and Messias da Silva Júnior's September 2025 preprint proving the conjecture for 1-parameter families of quasihomogeneous corank-1 surface germs; the Fernández de Bobadilla–Pełka family case dates to its April 2022 preprint and predates the snapshot.
